NETWORK_ERROR: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.
CONFLICT: The data has changed. Refresh and try again.
INTERNAL: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again later.
MODEL_CONFIG_VERIFICATION_TIMEOUT: Verification timed out because the upstream was too slow.
MODEL_CONFIG_NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the model URL. Check the network and API base URL.
MODEL_CONFIG_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Credentials were rejected. Check the API key.
MODEL_CONFIG_UPSTREAM_ERROR: The upstream returned an error. Check the URL and model name.
MODEL_CONFIG_RESPONSES_UNSUPPORTED: This URL does not support the Agentic Responses protocol, so verification cannot complete.
MODEL_CONFIG_TOOL_SEARCH_UNSUPPORTED: Tool-search probing failed, so tool capability cannot be confirmed.
MODEL_CONFIG_AGENTIC_STREAM_INVALID: The upstream stream did not match the Agentic protocol.
MODEL_CONFIG_AGENTIC_USAGE_INVALID: The upstream usage fields did not match the Agentic protocol.
